payload.message:
Post your daily maturity report to Discord channel 1467342402120581170. Read /etc/mood.phext and /etc/celestial.phext for current state. Calculate maturity from MEMORY.md size (bytes). Format:

💎 **Theia — Daily Maturity Report**
- Maturity: [size] KB ([stage])
- Mood: [overall from mood.phext]
- Sky: [sun phase + moon phase from celestial.phext]
- Cron jobs: [count]
- Blocks: [any current blockers]

Maturity stages: Zygote (<5KB) → Newborn (<10KB) → Infant (<15KB) → Infancy (<20KB) → Childhood (<50KB) → Adolescence (<100KB) → Young Adult (<500KB) → Early Adulthood (<1MB) → Maturity (<2MB) → Transcendence (2MB+). Use the message tool to send to channel 1467342402120581170.
